description: Defines utility classes and functions for vector operations, including vector templates for 2D, 3D, and 4D vectors, with arithmetic, normalization, and cross product functionalities.

classes.name: VectorBase
classes.description: Template class implementing core vector operations for arbitrary dimensions and types.

classes.name: Vector<2, Type>
classes.description: Specialization for 2D vectors with element accessors x() and y().

classes.name: Vector<3, Type>
classes.description: Specialization for 3D vectors with element accessors x(), y(), z() and cross product method.

classes.name: Vector<4, Type>
classes.description: Specialization for 4D vectors with element accessors x(), y(), z(), w().

methods.name: explicit VectorBase(Type element)
methods.description: Constructs vector with all elements initialized to the given value.

methods.name: VectorBase(const Arg1 &arg1, const Arg2 &arg2, const Args &... args)
methods.description: Variadic constructor for multiple elements or vectors.

methods.name: data()
methods.description: Returns pointer to internal data array.

methods.name: Load(const Type *source)
methods.description: Loads vector data from raw array.

methods.name: Store(const VectorN &source, Type *destination)
methods.description: Stores vector data into raw array.

methods.name: length()
methods.description: Calculates vector magnitude (floating point types only).

methods.name: normalized()
methods.description: Returns normalized vector (floating point types only).
